}

// Open the Create-PO drawer for one vendor group (all that vendor's shortage rows).
function psOpenCreatePo(vendorKey){
    const { buy } = psProcureData();
    const groupRows = buy.filter(r => (r.vendorName||'__NOVENDOR__') === vendorKey);
    if(!groupRows.length){ showToast('No parts to purchase for this vendor','info'); return; }
    const vRow = groupRows.find(r=>r.vendorId!=null);
    if(!vRow){ showToast('These parts have no vendor — cannot create a PO','error',5000); return; }
    // Default order qty = the shortfall (rounded up), BUT bumped to the vendor's
    // minimum order qty (vendorparts.qtyMin) when the MOQ is larger. moqApplied
    // flags the rows where the MOQ raised the qty so the drawer can say so.
    const parts = groupRows.map(r=>{
        const shortCeil = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Number(r.short)||0));
        const moq = (r.qtyMin!=null && r.qtyMin>0) ? r.qtyMin : 0;
        const moqApplied = moq > shortCeil;
        return {
            partId:String(r.partId), partNum:r.partNum, partDesc:r.partDesc||'', uom:r.uom||'',
            vendorPartNum:r.vendorPartNum||'', qtyMin:moq, shortCeil:shortCeil, moqApplied:moqApplied,
            qty:(moqApplied ? moq : shortCeil),
            unitCost:(r.lastCost!=null ? r.lastCost : 0),
            include:true,   // per-line include on the generated PO (item 6)
            pendingPos:(r.pendingPos||[]),   // existing Bid Request/pending POs for this part
            needBy:(r.earliest?r.earliest.clone():null)
        };
    });
    let lgList=[];
    try { const ids=(typeof getLocationGroupList==='function'?getLocationGroupList():[])||[];
          lgList = JSON.parse(runQuery('SELECT id, name FROM locationgroup WHERE activeflag = 1'+(ids.length?(' AND id IN ('+ids.join(',')+')'):'')+' ORDER BY name')); }
    catch(_){ lgList=[]; }
    // Default scheduled date = the earliest line need-by across the group (falls
    // back to today when no line has one). The user can override it in the drawer;
    // it is applied to every poItem's dateScheduled on submit.
    let schedDef=null; parts.forEach(p=>{ if(p.needBy && (!schedDef || p.needBy.isBefore(schedDef))) schedDef=p.needBy.clone(); });
    // Default the PO's LG to the LG the shortage actually sits in (the earliest-
    // needed row's lgId — which is the consuming WO's location_group_id, the SAME
    // field the availability engine consumes on). This guarantees the incoming
    // supply lands in the pool the demand draws from. Fall back to the user's
    // default LG only when the demand LG isn't in the accessible list.
    let poLg = psInitialLg(lgList);
    const poEr = groupRows.slice().sort((a,b)=>{ const av=a.earliest?a.earliest.valueOf():Infinity, bv=b.earliest?b.earliest.valueOf():Infinity; return av-bv; })[0];
    if(poEr && poEr.lgId && lgList.some(l=>String(l.id)===String(poEr.lgId))) poLg = String(poEr.lgId);
    // Initial status: the admin bid-lock forces Bid Request; otherwise the user's
    // remembered poCreateStatus default (falls back to Bid Request).
    const bidLocked = psPoBidLocked();
    let poStatus0 = 'Bid Request';
    if (bidLocked) poStatus0 = 'Bid Request';
    else { try { const s = FBLib.Settings.resolve('poCreateStatus'); if (s === 'Issued' || s === 'Bid Request') poStatus0 = s; } catch(_){} }
    psPoDraft = {
        vendorId: vRow.vendorId, vendorName: (vendorKey==='__NOVENDOR__'?'':vendorKey),
        parts, lgList, lgId:poLg,
        poStatus: poStatus0,   // 'Bid Request' | 'Issued'
        bidLocked: bidLocked,  // admin-forced Bid Request (status control disabled)
        cf: {},                // PO order-level custom-field values (item 5)
        // Scheduled date defaults to the day BEFORE the requiring WO's start (one-day
        // buffer) — schedDef is the earliest need-by (= that WO's date_scheduled_start).
        dateScheduled:(schedDef?schedDef.clone().subtract(1,'day'):moment()).format('YYYY-MM-DD'),
        note:'',
        state:'idle', error:null, result:null
    };
    psRenderPoDrawer();
    const p=document.getElementById('poPanel'), s=document.getElementById('poScrim');
    if(p) p.classList.add('on'); if(s) s.classList.add('on');
}

    const lgOpts=(d.lgList||[]).map(l=>'<option value="'+l.id+'"'+(String(l.id)===String(d.lgId)?' selected':'')+'>'+psEsc(l.name)+'</option>').join('') || '<option value="">(no accessible location groups)</option>';
    // Order status: forced to Bid Request (disabled) when the admin lock is on, else a select.

        : '<select onchange="psPoField(\'poStatus\',this.value)">'+['Bid Request','Issued'].map(s=>'<option'+(s===d.poStatus?' selected':'')+'>'+s+'</option>').join('')+'</select>';
    // PO order-level custom fields (item 5) — discovered from the PO table catalog so

    const pocfs=psLoadPoCustomFields();
    const cfHtml=pocfs.map(c=>{

        const val=(d.cf&&d.cf[c.name]!=null)?String(d.cf[c.name]):'';

async function psSubmitPo(){
    const d=psPoDraft; if(!d || d.state==='submitting') return;
    if(!d.vendorId){ d.error='No vendor on this order.'; psRenderPoDrawer(); return; }
    if(!d.lgId){ d.error='Choose a location group.'; psRenderPoDrawer(); return; }
    // Payload shape follows the documented POST /api/purchase-orders create body
    // (Fishbowl_Advanced_API_Tool "Create PO"): a poItem carries a numeric
    // quantity + totalCost — the LINE total (qty × unit cost); there is NO unitCost
    // field on create. part.name = the part number, type.id 10 = Purchase, and
    // dateScheduled = the line's scheduled fulfillment date.
    // The order-level scheduled date (chosen in the drawer) applies to every line;
    // fall back to the line's own need-by only if it is somehow blank/invalid.
    // Required PO custom fields must be filled or Fishbowl rejects the create.
    const pocfs=psLoadPoCustomFields();
    const cfMissing=pocfs.filter(c=>c.required && !(d.cf && d.cf[c.name]!=null && String(d.cf[c.name]).length)).map(c=>c.name);
    if(cfMissing.length){ d.error='Fill required custom field(s): '+cfMissing.join(', '); psRenderPoDrawer(); return; }
    const orderSched=(d.dateScheduled && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(d.dateScheduled)) ? d.dateScheduled : null;
    // Only INCLUDED lines with a qty > 0 go on the PO (item 6 — excluded lines route
    // to a different supplier; qty 0 isn't accepted by Fishbowl).
    const items=d.parts.filter(p=>p.include!==false && (parseFloat(p.qty)||0)>0).map(p=>{
        const qty=parseFloat(p.qty)||0, unit=parseFloat(p.unitCost)||0;
        const it={ part:{ id:parseInt(p.partId,10), name:p.partNum }, type:{ id:10 },
                   quantity:qty, totalCost:Number((qty*unit).toFixed(4)) };
        if(p.vendorPartNum) it.vendorPartNumber=p.vendorPartNum;
        const sched = orderSched || (p.needBy ? p.needBy.format('YYYY-MM-DD') : null);
        if(sched) it.dateScheduled=sched+'T00:00:00';
        return it;
    });
    if(!items.length){ d.error='Include at least one line with a quantity greater than 0.'; psRenderPoDrawer(); return; }
    if(typeof runRestApiAsync!=='function'){ d.error='REST API unavailable — open this report inside Fishbowl with REST enabled to create POs.'; psRenderPoDrawer(); return; }
    // Admin lock forces Bid Request regardless of the (disabled) control. Remember the
    // user's status choice for next time when not locked.
    const poStatus = d.bidLocked ? 'Bid Request' : (d.poStatus === 'Issued' ? 'Issued' : 'Bid Request');
    if(!d.bidLocked){ try { FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('poCreateStatus', poStatus); FBLib.Settings.saveUser(); } catch(_){} }
    const payload={ vendor:{ id:d.vendorId }, status:poStatus, locationGroup:{ id:d.lgId }, poItems:items };
    if(d.note && d.note.trim()) payload.note=d.note.trim();
    // Order-level custom fields (item 5). Same shape as the MO create's customFields.
    const cfArr=pocfs.map(c=>{ const v=d.cf?d.cf[c.name]:null; return (v!=null && String(v).length)?{ name:c.name, value:String(v) }:null; }).filter(Boolean);
    if(cfArr.length) payload.customFields=cfArr;
    d.state='submitting'; d.error=null; psRenderPoDrawer();
    try {
        const res=await runRestApiAsync({ method:'POST', path:'/api/purchase-orders', body:JSON.stringify(payload) });
        d.state='done'; d.result=res; psRenderPoDrawer();
        const num=(res && (res.number||res.num))||'';
        showToast('PO '+(num||'created')+' created', 'success', 4000);
        // Refresh the Procurement tab so the now-covered parts drop off.
        if(typeof loadWorkOrders==='function') loadWorkOrders();
    } catch(err){
        d.state='error';
        d.error = 'PO create failed: '+((err && (err.message||err.status!=null)) ? (err.message||('HTTP '+err.status)) : 'unknown error');
        psRenderPoDrawer();
    }
}

function initLgFilter() {
    try {
        const ids = (typeof getLocationGroupList === 'function' ? getLocationGroupList() : []) || [];
        // An empty accessible list means the user is unrestricted — show ALL active
        // location groups rather than an empty dropdown.
        const rows = JSON.parse(runQuery('SELECT id, name FROM locationgroup WHERE activeflag = 1' + (ids.length ? (' AND id IN (' + ids.join(',') + ')') : '') + ' ORDER BY name')) || [];
        const items = rows.map(r => ({ value: String(r.id), label: r.name }));
        _lgMs = FBLib.Common.MultiSelect.create({
            containerId: 'lgMs', items: items, selected: Array.from(flt.selLg), placeholder: 'All location groups', maxTags: 2,
            onClose: () => { flt.selLg.clear(); (_lgMs.getSelected() || []).forEach(v => flt.selLg.add(String(v))); saveState(); applyFilters(); render(); }
        });
    } catch (e) { debugLog('warn', 'LG filter init failed: ' + (e && e.message)); }
}
// Three search multi-selects (WO # · Raw Good part # · Finished Good part #) replace
// the old free-text box. Options are (re)populated from the loaded WOs after each
// load; selections re-query the view on close.
function initSearchFilters() {
    const mk = (id, ph, key) => {
        try {
            return FBLib.Common.MultiSelect.create({
                containerId: id, items: [], selected: [], placeholder: ph, maxTags: 2,
                onChange: vals => { flt[key].clear(); (vals || []).forEach(v => flt[key].add(String(v))); },
                onClose: () => { applyFilters(); render(); }
            });
        } catch (e) { debugLog('warn', id + ' init failed: ' + (e && e.message)); return null; }
    };
    _woMs = mk('woMs', 'All WO #s', 'selWo');
    _rawMs = mk('rawMs', 'All raw goods', 'selRaw');
    _fgMs = mk('fgMs', 'All finished goods', 'selFg');
}
// Fill the three search multi-selects from the loaded WOs (WO numbers, every consumed
// raw-good part number, and finished-good part numbers), dropping any stale selection.
function populateSearchFilters() {
    const woS = new Set();
    const rawMap = new Map();   // raw-good partNum -> description
    const fgMap = new Map();    // finished-good partNum -> description
    allWorkOrders.forEach(w => {
        if (w.wo_num) woS.add(String(w.wo_num));
        if (w.part_num) { const n = String(w.part_num); if (!fgMap.get(n)) fgMap.set(n, w.description || ''); }
        ((w._av && w._av.parts) || []).forEach(p => { if (p.partNum) { const n = String(p.partNum); if (!rawMap.get(n)) rawMap.set(n, p.partDesc || ''); } });
    });
    const numItems = set => Array.from(set).sort((a, b) => String(a).localeCompare(String(b))).map(v => ({ value: v, label: v }));
    // Clean a part's description for the sub-line: strip a leading repeat of the part
    // number + separator (Fishbowl stores MO/finished-good descriptions as
    // "NUM - Description", and some part descriptions are prefixed the same way), so the
    // sub-line shows just the human description — or nothing when it only repeats the number.
    const cleanDesc = (num, d) => {
        if (!d) return null;
        const esc = String(num).replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
        let s = String(d).trim().replace(new RegExp('^' + esc + '\\s*[-–—:]*\\s*', 'i'), '').trim();
        return (s && s !== String(num)) ? s : null;
    };
    // Part dropdowns: value = part number (what applyFilters matches on). Part number is
    // the bold main line; the cleaned description is a muted sub-line (searchable).
    // tagLabel keeps the selected chip compact.
    const partItems = map => Array.from(map.keys()).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b)).map(n => {
        return { value: n, label: n, sub: cleanDesc(n, map.get(n)), tagLabel: n };
    });
    const sync = (k, keys, ms, itemsArr) => {
        Array.from(flt[k]).forEach(v => { if (!keys.has(v)) flt[k].delete(v); });   // drop stale
        if (ms) { try { ms.setItems(itemsArr); ms.setSelected(Array.from(flt[k])); } catch (_) {} }
    };
    sync('selWo', woS, _woMs, numItems(woS));
    sync('selRaw', new Set(rawMap.keys()), _rawMs, partItems(rawMap));
    sync('selFg', new Set(fgMap.keys()), _fgMs, partItems(fgMap));
}
function init() {
    initSettings();
    initLgFilter();
    initSearchFilters();
    syncFilterChips();
    // Restore active tab.
    setTab(psView);
    loadWorkOrders();
}
